description: Modal dialog that interrupts the user flow to request confirmation before executing a destructive or irreversible action. Composed of AlertDialog, AlertDialogTrigger, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogAction, and AlertDialogCancel.
useCases: Confirming permanent deletion of surveys, responses, or user data
Warning before publishing or archiving a survey
Requesting explicit consent before overwriting existing data
Blocking navigation away from unsaved changes
